admission.EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED_RESEARCH_ELIGIBILITY: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Authentic attributable ROB package not established; no allocation or admission. A digest is not authentication.

commitments.buy_liability: buy expenditure plus conservative outstanding reservations; sell receipts excluded and cannot increase original budgets
commitments.history: Global contiguous chain and per-order immutable terms, recomputed reservation liabilities and reconciled transition sources
commitments.simultaneous_batches: Whole batch atomic rejection; no priority winners
commitments.terminal_release: Only reconciled accepted OMS terminal states; partial cancellation retains fill costs
commitments.sell_holdings: Replayed reconciled declared simulation history, instrument-wide splits, known transition history prefix and active reservations. No external-source completeness claim.

attribution.realised_component: Trade-only realised component; dividends disclosed separately and added exactly once.
attribution.net_pnl: Trade realised + unrealised + dividends. Funding/opening cash/adjustments excluded; embedded costs not subtracted again.
attribution.unsupported: INCOMPLETE_ATTRIBUTION for overlapping-position sales or shared corporate actions; no balancing entries
attribution.mismatch: INVALID for component or financial-source discrepancies

calendar.coverage: Every civil date from final completed monthly session through immediate next eligible session; established version/currentness and explicit closures
calendar.monthly_order_path: Engineering controller bootstrap fixes GENERIC or MONTHLY. MONTHLY requires qualified schedule at proposal and replay; omitted schedule cannot downgrade policy. Pure functions are calculations, not current-state authority.
calendar.removal: Controller retains accepted rebalance/removal transitions and obligations; client summaries cannot replace history. Existing pending exits remain cancellable without implicit liquidation.

stress.verification: Retained typed inputs recomputed against current sources and exact allocation membership; canonical ordering; no return-path/economic-edge claim
stress.unsupported: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; arbitrary metrics or IDs cannot qualify inputs

scope: Exactly three S4-13 files. No new evidence platform, journal extension, predecessor changes, dependencies, publication or sealing.

evidence_integrity.F1: USD allocation, original orders, fills, financial events and ledger/state must agree. Currency-less predecessor PerformanceTruth/ReconciliationResult inherit currency only through exact recomputation against verified sources. No conversion.
evidence_integrity.F2: Reservation creation, reconstructed initial history entries and final-evidence consumers share qualified schedule/order-release validation. Recomputed digests do not establish calendar facts.
evidence_integrity.F3: Removed strategy metadata is derived from retained ordered rebalance transitions. Each transition binds its preceding book, effective decision time, qualified calendar, OMS/ledger and obligations. Existing orders may reconcile/cancel; new reservations after removal cannot reconstruct.
evidence_integrity.boundary: Engineering simulation history only; no independent external completeness or production authority. No new evidence infrastructure.

option_b_engineering_controller.bootstrap: Fresh roots and zero-history configuration established by fixture launch, never by candidate commands.
option_b_engineering_controller.accepted_head: Separate retained bootstrap/head plus acknowledgement witnesses; expected references are CAS only; typed command replay reconstructs state. Configuration identity binds launch-selected storage roots. Identical retry repairs a missing acknowledgement witness before returning.
option_b_engineering_controller.idempotency: Identical command ID/payload returns current accepted state without posting; conflicting payload rejects.
option_b_engineering_controller.crash_semantics: Prepared records are not accepted. Exact retries resume tails. Head readback before acknowledgment. Conflicting tails fail closed. File fsync and atomic replace; no power-loss/OS durability or same-privilege filesystem isolation claim. Abrupt-process orphan locks fail closed pending explicit owner recovery.
option_b_engineering_controller.legacy: S4-11 journal API, schemas, command identities and TrustContext unchanged.
option_b_engineering_controller.configuration: Immutable fresh-epoch bootstrap is configuration establishment; no raw state replacement or automatic import.
option_b_engineering_controller.H01: Controller configuration mandates calendar policy; retained history governs removal.
option_b_engineering_controller.H02: One controller transition implementation used for proposal and replay; shared financial extension checks at pure consumers.
option_b_engineering_controller.H03: Retain infeasible split and reservations; block new reservation and qualified final evidence; explicit OMS cancellation/reconciliation resolves. Aggregate buy reservations also cannot exceed current ledger cash; funding withdrawal is retained and blocks reservations/evidence until resolved.
option_b_engineering_controller.H04: Residual cents only to positive weights with deterministic sorted ordering.
option_b_engineering_controller.H05: All traceability cases plus original T01-T18 and existing adversarial tests; exact collection/JUnit, final source hashes and native exits retained externally.
option_b_engineering_controller.downstream: S4-14/S4-15 must retain accepted-head reference and engineering limitations. External event completeness, authentic research eligibility and trading authority are NOT_ESTABLISHED.
option_b_engineering_controller.original_acceptance: Original T01-T18 meanings and mappings preserved; controller tests are additional.
limits: Orphan writer locks fail closed; no automatic deletion or takeover
